GET_TABLES: SELECT TABLE_CATALOG, TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, TABLE_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME
GET_DB_INFO: SELECT DB_NAME() AS DatabaseName, @@SERVERNAME AS ServerName, @@VERSION AS ServerVersion, GETDATE() AS CurrentDateTime
GET_COLUMNS: SELECT TOP 100 TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE, CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH, IS_NULLABLE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION
GET_SCHEMAS: SELECT SCHEMA_NAME, SCHEMA_OWNER FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA ORDER BY SCHEMA_NAME
GET_DB_SIZE: SELECT name AS FileName, CAST(size / 128.0 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS FileSizeMB, CAST((size / 128.0) - (CAST(FILEPROPERTY(name, 'SpaceUsed') AS FLOAT) / 128.0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS FreeSpaceMB FROM sys.database_files
